class.name: OcgGeom2dLine
class.brief_description: Describes an infinite line in the plane (2D space). A line is defined and positioned in the plane with an axis (gp_Ax2d object) which gives it an origin and a unit vector. The Geom2d_Line line is parameterized as follows: P (U) = O + U*Dir where: - P is the point of parameter U, - O is the origin and Dir the unit vector of its positioning axis. The parameter range is ] -infinite, +infinite [. The orientation of the line is given by the unit vector of its positioning axis. See Also GCE2d_MakeLine which provides functions for more complex line constructions gp_Ax2d gp_Lin2d for an equivalent, non-parameterized data structure.

The Geom2d_Line line is parameterized as follows: ! P (U) = O + U*Dir ! where: ! - P is the point of parameter U, ! - O is the origin and Dir the unit vector of its positioning axis. ! The parameter range is ] -infinite, +infinite [. ! The orientation of the line is given by the unit vector ! of its positioning axis. ! See Also ! GCE2d_MakeLine which provides functions for more ! complex line constructions ! gp_Ax2d ! gp_Lin2d for an equivalent, non-parameterized data structure.

method.name: from_1
method.description: Creates a line located in 2D space with the axis placement A. The Location of A is the origin of the line.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a line by conversion of the gp_Lin2d line L.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Constructs a line passing through point P and parallel to vector V (P and V are, respectively, the origin and the unit vector of the positioning axis of the line).

method.name: SetLin2d
method.description: Set <me> so that <me> has the same geometric properties as L.

method.name: SetDirection
method.description: changes the direction of the line.

method.name: Direction
method.description: changes the direction of the line.

method.name: SetLocation
method.description: Changes the "Location" point (origin) of the line.

method.name: Location
method.description: Changes the "Location" point (origin) of the line.

method.name: SetPosition
method.description: Changes the "Location" and a the "Direction" of <me>.

method.name: Lin2d
method.description: Returns non persistent line from gp with the same geometric properties as <me>

method.name: Reverse
method.description: Changes the orientation of this line. As a result, the unit vector of the positioning axis of this line is reversed.

method.name: ReversedParameter
method.description: Computes the parameter on the reversed line for the point of parameter U on this line. For a line, the returned value is -U.

method.name: FirstParameter
method.description: Returns RealFirst from Standard.

method.name: LastParameter
method.description: Returns RealLast from Standard

method.name: IsClosed
method.description: Returns False

method.name: IsPeriodic
method.description: Returns False

method.name: Continuity
method.description: Returns GeomAbs_CN, which is the global continuity of any line.

method.name: Distance
method.description: Computes the distance between <me> and the point P.

method.name: IsCN
method.description: Returns True.

method.name: EvalD0
method.description: Returns in P the point of parameter U. P (U) = O + U * Dir where O is the "Location" point of the line and Dir the direction of the line.

method.name: EvalDN
method.description: For the point of parameter U of this line, computes the vector corresponding to the Nth derivative. Note: if N is greater than or equal to 2, the result is a vector with null magnitude. Exceptions Standard_RangeError if N is less than 1.

method.name: Transform
method.description: Applies the transformation T to this line.

method.name: TransformedParameter
method.description: Computes the parameter on the line transformed by T for the point of parameter U on this line. For a line, the returned value is equal to U multiplied by the scale factor of transformation T.

method.name: ParametricTransformation
method.description: Returns the coefficient required to compute the parametric transformation of this line when transformation T is applied. This coefficient is the ratio between the parameter of a point on this line and the parameter of the transformed point on the new line transformed by T. For a line, the returned value is the scale factor of the transformation T.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
